Maya (CSM): Heads-up — AltumEnergy renewal in ~6w looks shaky. Usage fell off after their PM left, and procurement is sniffing around for alternatives.
Jared (AE): Yikes. Do we have hard numbers?
Maya (CSM): last 30d active seats 45 -> 7, API calls/day 9k -> 800. Champion (Lina) left last month. Procurement mentioned a ByteServe pilot. :worried:
Priya (SuccessEng): I can do a tech touchpoint Thurs. Any recent errors or config changes we should know about?
Maya (CSM): No errors in logs. Feedback = latency spikes and perceived cost. They want predictable latency + a clearer cost comparison.
Oliver (RevOps): We can offer a short Dedicated trial (6w) with a discounted rate — pricing says it's doable if AE + CSM align on scope.
Jared (AE): Agree. I'll prep a one-pager for procurement. Maya — can you list the top asks we need to address in the POC?
Maya (CSM): Top asks: 1) p95 latency SLO for common flows, 2) clear cost per 1M tokens at target QPS, 3) migration playbook for their infra team, 4) sample eval prompts.
Priya (SuccessEng): I'll draft an ops checklist and run a quick perf comparison (current hosted vs dedicated + KV cache + quantization). Will test with their sample payloads.
deploy-bot: Trial cluster `altum-energy-poc` created in eu-west-1 by @Priya. Dashboard: https://console.redwood/alloc/altum-poc
Priya (SuccessEng): Quick perf preview: `p95 220ms -> 48ms with caching`, estimated cost delta ~-32% for their 1M token baseline. I'll attach CSV to the playbook.
Oliver (RevOps): I'll provision promo code `6W-DED-40OFF` pending legal signoff and add a short billing note for procurement.
Jared (AE): Please also schedule an exec QBR with their interim CTO + procurement. Need to reestablish sponsor.
Maya (CSM): On it — aiming for next Tue. I'll include the one-pager and Priya's perf notes.
Jared (AE): If we get the trial live and show the latency & cost wins vs ByteServe, we can likely salvage the renewal. Post updates here. :crossed_fingers:
Maya (CSM): Will do. Next update after Priya's full run and the AE one-pager are ready.
